title: Gradient-Only Online Convex Optimization with a Single Quadratic Leader
summary: We study online convex optimization on a bounded Euclidean domain when the learner receives only one subgradient at its prediction and knows neither the horizon, a gradient bound, nor the losses' strong-convexity parameters. We present a scale-invariant algorithm that couples projected adaptive gradient descent to one cone-constrained quadratic leader through a positive wealth process. The algorithm maintains $O(d)$ state, without a learning-rate grid or restarts.
